name: Trench Pilgrims
source: Warbands of Trench Crusade 1.0.2; Procession of the Sacred Affliction Warband 1.0.2 (2026); Carcass Front Errata

mercenaries.note: Faithful mercenaries hireable by Trench Pilgrim warbands (costs in Glory). War Pilgrimage of Saint Methodius bans Ammo Monks and Communicant Anti-Tank Hunters.

models.name: War Prophet
models.kitRule: any

abilities.name: Loudspeakers ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll at +2 DICE (failure ends the Activation). On success every friendly model within 8" may move up to 3" and must end as close as possible to the nearest enemy it could see; reaching 1" counts as a charge.

abilities.name: Laying on of Hands ACTION
abilities.text: Success Roll: on a success remove 1 BLOOD MARKER from a friendly model within 6" (3 on a critical); may target itself.

abilities.name: Memento Mori
abilities.text: The first Out of Action result this model suffers counts as No Effect. It can never have the TOUGH Keyword.

models.name: Communicant
models.kitRule: any, plus a free Communicant Cross (counts as Iron Capirote and Gas Mask, cannot be lost)

abilities.name: Bodyguard
abilities.text: When a friendly PILGRIM within 1" is hit by a ranged or melee attack, this model may take the Injury Roll instead. Not against BLAST attacks.

abilities.name: The Communicant Cross
abilities.text: Counts as having an Iron Capirote (Headgear) and a Gas Mask at no cost.

models.name: Castigator
models.kitRule: any

abilities.name: Enforced Orthodoxy ACTION
abilities.text: Risky Success Roll at +1 DICE (failure ends the Activation). On success all Down friendly models within 8" stand up at no movement cost.

abilities.name: Whip of God
abilities.text: May make melee attacks against a friendly model within 1". Each friendly model it takes Out of Action this way banks +1 DICE for the warband's next Morale Check.

upgrades.name: Zealot Strength
upgrades.text: Gains the STRONG Keyword.

models.name: Trench Pilgrim
models.kitRule: any

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.text: Campaign only: a Pilgrim killed after a game may return as a Martyr Penitent (Melee +1 DICE, -1 INJURY DICE to its Injury Rolls, Martyrdom Pills useless) for 45 ducats.

upgrades.name: Zealot Strength
upgrades.text: Gains STRONG and moves to a 32mm base. Only 1 Trench Pilgrim/Martyr Penitent per warband.

models.name: Stigmatic Nun
models.kitRule: armoury, but only Automatic Pistols and Pistols as ranged weapons and only Warcrosses as grenades

abilities.name: Agile
abilities.text: +1 DICE to Risky Success Rolls to Climb, Jump, Diving Charge or Dash.

abilities.name: Blessed Stigmata
abilities.text: Each BLOOD MARKER removed by REGENERATE 1 is replaced by 1 BLESSING MARKER.

models.name: Ecclesiastic Prisoner
models.kitRule: always has an Iron Capirote; up to 4 may buy a Martyrdom Device; nothing else

abilities.name: Awaited
abilities.text: A Prisoner taken Out of Action by its own Martyrdom Device does not count towards Morale Checks.

abilities.name: Feeble Flailing
abilities.text: Can make melee attacks with no melee weapon at -1 DICE.

abilities.name: Mad Dash
abilities.text: +1 DICE to Risky Success Rolls to Dash.

upgrades.name: Martyrdom Device
upgrades.text: Up to 4 per warband. See Martyrdom Device in uniqueKit.

models.name: Anchorite Shrine
models.kitRule: only its built-in Bonebreaker Mace and Catherine Wheel

abilities.name: Broken on the Wheel
abilities.text: Before deployment you may sacrifice one Trench Pilgrim or Ecclesiastic Prisoner (removed from the warband permanently; in a campaign its kit can be redistributed at the next Quartermaster Step). Until the Shrine's first Out of Action result: Armour 0, no NEGATE SHRAPNEL or TOUGH, Down results count as Minor Hits, and that first Out of Action counts as No Effect (remove its BLOOD MARKERS); afterwards normal profile (Armour -3, NEGATE SHRAPNEL, TOUGH) applies.

abilities.name: Symphony of Slaughter
abilities.text: Attacks once with either built-in weapon, or twice: Catherine Wheel then Bonebreaker Mace (off-hand modifier on the second). Both are RISKY.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.text: Has the FEAR Keyword.

uniqueKit.name: Holy Icon Shield
uniqueKit.text: Miracle-working icon on blessed wood used as a shield.

uniqueKit.name: Iron Capirote
uniqueKit.text: Blessed conical helmet; counts as Headgear.

uniqueKit.name: Punt Gun
uniqueKit.text: Overcharge: before shooting, a STRONG model or one touching a friendly model may overcharge; the attack gains BLAST 3 and RELOAD, then the shooter takes 1 BLOOD MARKER and its Activation ends.

overcharge.needs: STRONG or friendly model in contact

uniqueKit.name: Warcross

uniqueKit.name: Martyrdom Device

sim.injury: all models within 3" incl. self (self rolls 4D6); +1 INJURY DICE within 1"
